decision: Unrelated compilation and other workloads were observed during timing; this candidate does not establish the 2x API target or smaller code. All documentation regressions and raw processes are retained. Replace these uncommitted scanner/counter changes with an evaluation of remaining label-string temporaries against the unchanged committed baseline.
baselineReuseNote: Unchanged committed production baseline, reused after fresh CPU sampling and complete source/binary fingerprint checks. The rejected scanner-map experiment is not the baseline.
method: Original extended Rust bench.rs driver: 5 warm-ups, >=10ms calibration, >=9 samples and >=300ms per operation per run. Three independent processes per version, alternating order. Every verification record must match across all six runs.
interpretation: All groups and individual process medians retained, including regressions. Equal-weight means describe this input set; small differences are not statistical significance claims. Allocation instrumentation and CPU sampling run separately from timing.

measurementConditions.interpretation: A read-only process snapshot found unrelated compilation and other workloads during timing. It proves contention at observation time only and does not quantify the contribution to any regression. All timing runs are retained; these measurements alone will not establish target attainment. Raw machine-specific process details remain ignored.

releaseSizeMethod: Full-feature release CLI/FFI, identical locked dependencies and profile, remapped source paths, no stripping. Actual instruction text is reported separately from complete file bytes. Static archive totals precede host linker selection/dead stripping.
